name: Sport Shooter: The Eight Galleries
storyline:
Welcome to the Sport Shooting Rifle event!

The rules are simple. At each of the eight shooting ranges:

1. Pick up the rifle.
2. Aim through the sights.
3. Shoot as close to the center of the target as you can.

You will gain more points the closer you get to the target. Each rifle only has one shot, so dispose of it after firing.

Once you have completed all of the ranges, return to the entrance and exit through the door.

As you are completing the ranges, you may notice an incorporeal presence.

Do not approach the presence.
Do not let the presence touch you.
Sounds will alert the presence to your position.

Death will disqualify you from the event.
Time out will disqualify you from the event.

Good luck!
summary: Take part in the Sport Shooting Rifle event. Navigate a sprawling complex while testing your nerves and your aim. Hit targets under pressure and race against time as you are pursued by a ghostly presence. Try to make it out alive.
